t_advice_summary_textbox.text: According to the giver of advice, I should always choose RED, BLUE, GREEN and BROWN. Yellow and orange gave average results whilst purple and pink gave around 0 points.

vb_textbox.text: I wish I could be of more help however I wasn't able to find a pattern. I was given the advice of staying away from the pink and purple gnomes however I received a large amount of mushrooms from them multiple times.
